announcements.text: General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), Falls Church, Virginia, is awarded a contract modification to increase the contract ceiling by $56,000,000, from the current $98,500,000 to $154,500,000 on indefinitely-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N0003925D7800) in order to execute on the Secretary of the Navy's (SECNAV's) mandate (i.e., Operation Cattle Drive) to consolidate all legacy help desks into the Navy Enterprise service desk by Oct. 1, 2027. Work will continue to be performed in Bossier City, Louisiana (50%); and New Orleans, Louisiana (50%). This contract is in its second year of performance under Option Year One (August 2026 through August 2027). There is one optional year remaining which, if exercised, would bring the estimated cumulative value to $154,500,000 and performance will continue until August 2028. In accordance with 10 U.S. Code 4022(f), Other Transactions Authority (OTA), this production contract follows the successful completion of GDIT's OTA prototype effort that originated in 2019. Portfolio Acquisition Executive Mission Systems, San Diego, California, is the contracting activity.

contracting_activity.name: Portfolio Acquisition Executive Mission Systems, San Diego, California

extracted.contract_type: indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (ceiling increase; production follow-on to OTA prototype)
extracted.description: Ceiling increase to consolidate legacy help desks into the Navy Enterprise service desk (Operation Cattle Drive)

announcements.text: Systems Planning and Analysis (SPA), Inc., Alexandria, Virginia, is awarded a $55,670,496 cost-plus-fixed-fee term task order (N0003027F3024) for Trident II Strategic Weapons System (SWS) support. This value includes optional line items, if exercised. Tasks to be performed include technical assessments, and studies, systems engineering and analysis support, and program integration and schedule support. Work will be performed in Washington, D.C. (60%); Alexandria, Virginia (32%); Bangor, Washington (1%); Denver, Colorado (1%); Titusville, Florida (1%); Kings Bay, Georgia (1%); Pittsfield, Massachusetts (1%); Valley Forge, Pennsylvania (1%); Magna, Utah (1%); and Sunnyvale, California (1%). Work is expected to be completed on Sep. 30, 2031. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $200,981; fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $150,000; and fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds in the amount of $1,348,216, will be obligated on this award. Funding in the amount of $200,981 will expire at the end of fiscal 2027. This contract also benefits a Foreign Military Sale to the United Kingdom. This task order will be awarded as a sole source acquisition with the authority of 15 U.S. Code 638 Research and Development. Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Strategic Systems Programs, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Performance Aircraft Services Inc.,* Grapevine, Texas, is awarded an $11,840,244 firm-fixed-price modification (P00002) to a previously awarded contract to exercise an option for depot-level maintenance of Navy E-6B Mercury aircraft. Work includes removal of existing sealant using medium-pressure water stripping, primer application, sealant reapplication, and fuel-cell pressure checks. Work will be performed in Lake Charles, Louisiana (50%); and Oklahoma City, Oklahoma (50%), and is expected to be completed in December 2027. Fiscal 2027 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $11,840,244 will be obligated at time of award. This contract modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N0001926C1005).

announcements.text: Ipsos Public Affairs LLC, Norwalk, Connecticut, is awarded an $11,605,631 option (P00012) to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price task order (HT001123F0033) to support the TRICARE Patient Experience Survey effort. This effort provides Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) surveys for the Defense Health Agency, including (a) surveys of recently discharged adult and pediatric inpatients; (b) the CAHPS Clinician and Group Survey; and (c) the CAHPS Outpatient and Ambulatory Surgery Survey. The task order was competitively awarded, effective June 1, 2023. The cumulative value of the task order, including the exercised option, is $67,661,809. Fiscal year 2027 operations and maintenance funds will be provided. The place of performance is Falls Church, Virginia. The period of performance for the option year is Dec. 1, 2026, through Nov. 30, 2027. DHA, Professional Services Contracting Division, Falls Church, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

contracting_activity.name: DHA, Professional Services Contracting Division, Falls Church, Virginia

extracted.description: TRICARE Patient Experience Survey (CAHPS surveys) option year

announcements.text: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., Hawthorne, California, has been awarded a $9,921,992 broad agency announcement contract, with options for up to a maximum $12,666,379, for a risk reduction study on their Plug and Play Laser, also known as Plaser. This contract provides for the risk reduction study, the delivery of representative hardware, and support to missile warning and tracking system integration. Work will be performed in Hawthorne, California; and Redmond, Washington, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 7, 2027. This contract was a competitive acquisition. Since proposals are received throughout the year under the Systems, Technologies, and Emerging Capabilities Broad Agency Announcement, the number of proposals received in response to the solicitation is unknown. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation funds in the amount of $9,921,992 are being obligated at the time of award. The Space Development Agency, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (FA240127C0001). (Awarded on Nov. 9, 2026).
